title: Wilfully disobeying superior commissioned officer.
bodyText:
Any person subject to this chapter who wilfully disobeys a lawful command of that person's superior commissioned officer shall be punished:

(1) If the offense is committed in time of war, by confinement of no more than ten years or other punishment as directed by a court-martial; and

(2) If the offense is committed at any other time, by punishment as directed by a court-martial.
bodyHtml:
[§124B-146]  Wilfully disobeying superior commissioned officer.  Any person subject to this chapter who wilfully disobeys a lawful command of that person's superior commissioned officer shall be punished:

     (1)  If the offense is committed in time of war, by confinement of no more than ten years or other punishment as directed by a court-martial; and

     (2)  If the offense is committed at any other time, by punishment as directed by a court-martial. [L 2022, c 286, pt of §2]
